- [IRET.28.10.2] For the iterated tables (`alpha_mem`, `wm_bucket`,
  `wm_table`) the dense order **must** be insertion order, and a removal
  **must** move the last entry into the hole it leaves. Entries inserted
  in the same sequence then iterate in the same order on every platform.
  The conformance bit-identity / replay-determinism tests are the gate
  (`[IRET.28.16]`).
